parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning, library services.

Oh, good morning. My family and I have recently moved to the area and we'd like to find where our nearest library is. We don't have a car.

Right, so whereabouts are you?

In Perth-on, in the west.

Fine, so I'll just get the details on screen for you. OK, your nearest one is the Minack Library.

— Minack?

Yes, in Skellarn Street.

— Can you spell that?

It's S K E L L A R N Street.

— Got that.

It's very easy to find because it's beside a park.

Oh, I think I know that area. There's a sports centre near there, isn't there?

I don't know of one.

I'm probably mistaken. Anyway, it's probably a bit far for us to walk from there. Are there any buses?

Yes, it's well served by public transport. There's a stop about five minutes away.

Oh, right. And when does the library open? We'll most often want to come at the weekend.

I'm afraid it's not open on Sunday.

— Saturday?

Opens at 9.00 and closes at 4.30. We shut at 5.00 on weekdays.

That's fine. Now, I've got two kids — fourteen and nine — and I wondered whether you have any special activities for them. In our last place, we had an art club.

Well, the library does run a drama club, but that would only be suitable for your younger child. It's open for five- to thirteen-year-olds.

A pity it's not open to both of them. Have you anything they could both go to?

Well, there's no reading club that would suit them both. Oh, but there is a singing club that's held every second Saturday afternoon for children of all ages up to sixteen.

Excellent.

Now, because we're new to the area, I'm also wanting to get involved in local activities.

Well, Minack does some sessions for adults as well. There's a book of the month club.

That's good. And I know that about once every twelve months, they have a session where you can meet artists, you know, from the local area.

How interesting. Well, that sounds like a full programme. Now, while I'm on the phone, can I check what the facilities are? Can you take out CDs?

Not CDs, I'm afraid, but films, yes.

Right, I'll make a note of that.

Anything else you need to know?

Oh yes, we have ten computers and we also stock several magazines, including business, healthcare and hobbies.

Same as my last place.

And there is a new drop-off facility where you can post any item through the door if it's after hours. All you have to do is attach a note to it with the number on your card clearly written.

That sounds good.

And we do have a small shop on the premises where we sell postcards. We don't have many, but it's a popular service.

Oh, that's a good idea.

They're very popular. We also have an impressive range of maps of the surrounding area for sale.

Well, it sounds like you've got...

analyses.content: Yes, in Skellarn Street. It's S K E L L A R N Street.
务必注意听最后一个字母 N，不要因为它发音较轻或连读就漏掉了，导致拼写错误。
录音中男士非常清晰地逐个字母拼写了街道名称：S-K-E-L-L-A-R-N。
男士说图书馆非常好找，因为它就在一个 park（公园）的旁边（beside）。
It's very easy to find because it's beside a park. Oh, I think I know that area. There's a sports centre near there, isn't there? I don't know of one.
你可能听到 sports centre（体育中心），但那只是女士凭印象说的，男士随后否认了它的存在。
Opens at 9.00 and closes at 4.30. We shut at 5.00 on weekdays.
千万别填成 5.00，录音说的是平日（weekdays）才在 5 点关门。
男士明确告知，周六的营业时间是早上 9 点开门，下午 4.30 关门。
In our last place, we had an art club. Well, the library does run a drama club, but that would only be suitable for your younger child. It's open for five- to thirteen-year-olds.
不要听到 art club 就填，那是女士搬家前那个地方有的活动，不是这家图书馆的。
录音提到图书馆举办了一个 drama（戏剧）俱乐部，并且强调它只适合 5 到 13 岁的孩子。
Well, there's no reading club that would suit them both. Oh, but there is a singing club that's held every second Saturday afternoon for children of all ages up to sixteen.
录音先否定了 reading club（读书俱乐部），因为它不适合两个人同时参加，要注意听否定的语气。
男士介绍说有一个 singing（歌唱）俱乐部，每隔一个周六举办一次，适合两个孩子。
男士说大约每 12 个月有一次聚会，大家可以见到当地的 artists（艺术家）。
And I know that about once every twelve months, they have a session where you can meet artists, you know, from the local area.
注意这里是指一类人，所以要用复数形式 artists，漏写 's' 会扣分。
Can you take out CDs? Not CDs, I'm afraid, but films, yes.
一定要听清 "Not CDs" 这个否定词，答案在转折词 "but" 后面。
女士问能不能借 CD，男士否定了 CD，但确认可以借 films（电影）。
Oh yes, we have ten computers and we also stock several magazines, including business, healthcare and hobbies.
不要填具体的分类（如 business 或 healthcare），题目空前是 various，需要填总称名词。
录音说图书馆储备了几种 magazines（杂志），随后列举了商业、健康等具体类别。
All you have to do is attach a note to it with the number on your card clearly written.
不要填 note，note 是你要附上的东西，题目问的是卡片上的什么信息（card number）。
男士解释说还书只需附上一张纸条，上面清楚地写着你卡片上的 number（号码）。
And we do have a small shop on the premises where we sell postcards. We don't have many... We also have an impressive range of maps of the surrounding area for sale.
Postcards（明信片）是前面提到的 "small selection"（只有少量），题目要求的 "wide range" 对应录音中的 "impressive range"。
录音最后提到店里出售一系列令人印象深刻的周边地区 maps（地图）。
